title: MCPDisCo: Seesaw-Mitigated Tuning for MCP-Native Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.14956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Model Context Protocol provides a shared interaction substrate for the agentic web, allowing heterogeneous services to expose capabilities through a standardized interface. Learning to use this ecosystem entails a hierarchy of capabilities: tool-format skills, server-level transfer, and cross-server composition. We present MCPDisCo, an ecosystem-scale reinforcement learning framework for MCP-native agents. Using a Thought-Markov Decision Process (Thought-MDP), the framework explicitly represents internal reasoning alongside routing, execution, and termination and trains on real-server, long-horizon interactions spanning 70 MCP servers and 527 tools across six domains. We study the reasoning--tool seesaw, a joint-learning failure mode in which improvement in one objective can accompany deterioration in the other. To mitigate potential interference, MCPDisCo combines token-masked reward attribution with bidirectional gradient surgery:

translated_title: MCPDisCo：面向MCP原生智能体的跷跷板缓解调优方法
translated_abstract: 模型上下文协议为智能体网络提供了共享的交互基础，允许异构服务通过标准化接口暴露其能力。学习使用这一生态系统需要具备层次化的能力：工具格式技能、服务器级迁移以及跨服务器组合。我们提出了MCPDisCo，一个面向MCP原生智能体的生态系统级强化学习框架。该框架采用思维马尔可夫决策过程，将内部推理与路由、执行和终止显式地表示在一起，并在跨越六个领域、70个MCP服务器和527个工具的真实服务器长时程交互上进行训练。我们研究了推理-工具跷跷板效应，这是一种联合学习的失败模式，其中一个目标的提升可能伴随着另一个目标的退化。为缓解潜在的干扰，MCPDisCo将令牌掩码奖励归因与双向梯度手术相结合：
tldr: 该论文提出MCPDisCo框架，通过思维MDP显式建模推理过程，并利用令牌掩码奖励归因与双向梯度手术缓解强化学习中推理与工具使用能力之间的“跷跷板”效应，在覆盖70个服务器和527个工具的真实环境中训练MCP原生智能体。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MCPDisCo, an ecosystem-scale reinforcement learning framework for MCP-native agents that mitigates the reasoning-tool seesaw effect through token-masked reward attribution and bidirectional gradient surgery, trained on real-server long-horizon interactions spanning 70 MCP servers and 527 tools.
